data.name: Seance Boon
data.description: For the purpose of spells and effects that have an effect based on which deity you worship, you count as worshiping the deity chosen in your vow. For the purpose of divinations, your alignment is the same as the deity's, and you have an aura corresponding to that deity's alignment as if you were a cleric of that deity. This doesn't alter other effects based on alignment, like smite evil.
